inventory.interpretation: The 186 aggregate AC1021 source-frame observer callbacks are 74 opaque carriers plus 112 standard-object frames. Bounded physical selected-output routes now qualify 70 opaque carriers: 25 VISUALSTYLE, 17 SCALE, 12 DICTIONARYVAR, three MATERIAL, one DBCOLOR, one ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT, one ACDBPLACEHOLDER, two ACDBSECTIONVIEWSTYLE, two ACDBDETAILVIEWSTYLE, one MLEADERSTYLE, one MLINESTYLE, one TABLESTYLE, and one CELLSTYLEMAP. They qualify 77 standard-object frames; output routes verify typed/raw readback and applicable dependency closure, refusal and retry. The remaining four opaque carriers and 35 standard-object frames remain unqualified; source-byte capture or matching typed callbacks alone do not qualify serialization.

candidateBoundary.result: PASS. All 25 source styles have one extension dictionary owned by the style; each dictionary has one ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP entry to an XRECORD owned by that dictionary and reacting back to it. Mutation refusal preserves a destination sentinel and the same writer succeeds after source restoration. This is selected-graph evidence only.
